reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open of Chronicle's live Apollo ACRDX Proof of Asset dashboard on 2026-08-08 confirms the same three category buckets reported on 2026-07-28: Apollo Diversified Credit-I Fund shares, cash, and an unidentified cryptocurrency balance. Two-decimal weights remain 97.11%, 2.73%, and 0.16% (sum 100). The 0.16% cryptocurrency slice is verified by Chronicle only at the aggregate level; the underlying token is not identified. Because the exposure is small (well below 1% of gross holdings) and no further granular disclosure is available, it is accepted as a bounded known-unknown rather than blocking the entire reserve review. Cash counterparties and the gross-holdings-to-NAV residual also remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle-verified gross feeder-fund holdings, reconciled to ACRDX NAV and on-chain Chronicle VAO Poked value; the 2026-08-08 re-open confirmed the same weights reported by the 2026-07-27 attestation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Chronicle labels USD 70,838.76, or 0.16% of gross holdings, only as cryptocurrency; it does not identify the token. Cash counterparties, the look-through obligor schedule inside the Apollo fund share, and the ~USD 39,473 gross-holdings-to-NAV difference are also unexplained, while the feeder-level asset categories and weights are reported.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The backing asset is an identified Apollo fund share rather than a Pharos-tracked stablecoin dependency.
Cash is an exogenous reserve asset; the current feeder-fund weight is independently verified even though bank counterparties are not disclosed.

Chronicle verifies the aggregate cryptocurrency value but does not identify the constituent token. The exposure is bounded at 0.16% of gross holdings, so the reserve review proceeds with an explicit basket-needs-split disposition rather than blocking on this slice.
